items.title: What Is Meta Platforms (META) Facing As Legal Risks Rise And AI Deals Expand?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) joined Google and TikTok in suing California to block a new youth social media law targeting users under 16. Police in India registered a First Information Report against Meta after complaints over alleged child sexual abuse material on Instagram and Facebook. AMD disclosed agreements under which Meta may gain rights to about 320 million AMD shares as part of AI chip related deals.
